Talking about food,
Interestingly, they serve combos of breakfast for just 100₹ as follows,
1. Sheera, Poha, Batata Vada, & Elaichi Banana
2. Upma, Medu Vada, Mini Uttapam & Elaichi Banana
Have tried 2nd one more than once and it's nice on so many levels. It's a perfect combo to start your day with.
Apart from that snacks like are as follows:
1. Kothimbir Vadi (कोथिंबीर वडी) is niiice,
2. Misal (मिसळ) with पाव (bread) or पुरी (poori) is again a fulfilling combination,
3. Alu Wadi (अळु वडी) is crispy and tasty (they serve just 2 pieces and these vadis are deliciously awesome!!),
4. Batata Vada Sambar is awesome and fulfilling (can be someone's meal too 😋),
5. Corn Patties is also nice,
6. Pineapple raita is basically chopped pineapples in sweet curd and I am not fan of.sweet but it was yummy
7. Sabudana Kahichdi is so like the one we make at our homes (They don't serve dahi with Khichdi)
8. Sabudana Vada is lovely and served with Dahi
9. Dahi Vada is yummy
10. Gulkand ice cream is gonna make you forget everything  and is genuinely a must have
11. Very decent and yummy lemon coriander Soup
.
Lunch has Gravy Sabji+Dry Sabji+Rice+Chapaati+Koshimbir(Cucumbar-curd salad)+Daal+Paapad+Gulab Jamun and it's superbly healthy as well as tasty and worth the money.
Apart from this they have rice combo too.
I am done. This is one of the very best consistent at food and cleanliness restaurants i had been to.
They accept all card payments and paytm as well.

Visited this place with my ex-colleagues, and to be honest, The vibe of the place is great for spending time with family.

We ordered quite a few dishes including prawns masala fry, bombil masala, bombil rawa fry, grilled pomfret, crab lollipop, chicken, and finally prawns biryani.

Talking about the food, the crab lollipop was interesting. It obviously felt like frozen food, but the taste was still good. However, most of the seafood dishes were a little disappointing for us. The fish dishes were not spicy enough and lacked that strong flavor we were expecting. The stuffed pomfret was just okay-okay and felt more like boiled fish rather than properly fried.

We also ordered a chicken dish and specifically requested it to be spicy, but unfortunately, it turned out a bit sweet, and none of us really liked it.

But the highlight of the meal was definitely the prawns biryani. It was really, really good and honestly the best dish we had there.

If there are two dishes I would recommend to anyone visiting, it has to be the Bombil Fry and Peri Peri Bombil. They are easily my brother’s and my absolute favourites perfectly crispy, full of flavour, and something we end up ordering almost every single time.

And no meal here feels complete without the Kokum Sarbat or Kokum Soda. That refreshing, tangy punch of flavour just balances the seafood so well and makes the whole experience even better.

Good food, great flavours, and the comfort of family dinners this place truly feels special to us. Easily one of the best seafood restaurants and definitely a spot we’ll keep coming back to.

This was the final restaurant I attended on my trip and a great place to end on.

Unfortunately at the time of our attendance the A/C was not in working order which the manager/owner advised on prior to entering, however we still went in as they had fans going on.

Didn't plan to eat a lot but to take in the delights on offer as again this was a place recommended.

We were given good information by the manager on some of the dishes and on ordering the food arrived after a short time. temperatures were on point and flavours were amazing. The prawn starters were so good, especially the Prawns Garlic Butter, so much so we ordered another tray. I also order the Mutton Chops Ghee Roast and as it sat in front of me my mouth was watering. Spice level on this was perfect, had a nice little kick but was really enjoyable and not in a overpowering way. I found that the chop may have been slightly overdone to my liking, however this didn't take the enjoyment away from it.

The meals ordered were enjoyed by everyone in the party which also included children (they really enjoyed the Prawns Garlic Butter). Pricing of the meals and overall was very reasonable and this place is worth a visit if you have never been. I will look to return here again if I visit Mumbai again.

Had an absolutely fantastic Malvani seafood lunch at Malwani Aswad in Vile Parle East. The best part about this place is how close the flavours are to authentic homemade Malvani/Konkani food, rich, fresh, and 100% true to the cuisine. The menu has a huge variety, and it’s rare to find places serving premium fish like Chonak, depending on availability of course.
We started with Tisrya Sukha, and it was bursting with flavour — fleshy clams and a sukha masala that was an absolute banger. The Bombil Fry, Chonak Fry, and Prawns Fry were all incredibly fresh and perfectly fried. The Surmai curry was beautifully balanced, and the Solkadhi paired wonderfully with the meal. Had it all with bhakri and a little rice, and the portions were very generous.
The restaurant is small, but spotlessly clean, very well maintained, and clearly run with a lot of passion. You may have to wait during peak hours, but it is 100% worth the wait. Special shoutout to the owners for serving such authentic flavours with consistency and care. Wishing you bigger success ahead  truly one of the best Malvani food experiences in Mumbai. 🌊🐟🔥

Then it is topped with cheeses later baked in grill. I liked this dish mainly because of it size. I would say its like a small boom of flavors. I would recommend you to try this dish and pair it with a sweet mocktail.

The second dish was The Corn Cheese Kurkure. This is a very good veg starters and I would go for this dish over many non-veg starters. This is a crispy dish with a very creamy filling. The inner filling is made up of palak paste mixed with cheese and corn, which is wrapped around spring roll wrap and the entire thing is deep fried until golden brown. This dish is served in shot glasses filled in green chutney and garnished with cheese. You can eat this dish like a finger sticks and its really enjoyable dish.

The Next dish was the Falafal Pocket. This is a middle eastern dish which is prepared very nicely by the restaurant. Basically what this dish is a fluffy form of pita bread which is stuffed with a creamy salad. This restaurant fills the bread with very little salad and serves the rest as side dish so as to fill it more as per your individual needs. They also serve Humus sauce which is prepared by their chef to go along with this dish. The texture of the dish is very tempting wanting you to fill it with more of the salad. If you want something new to eat go for this dish.

Then I went for the Main course in which the first was Panner in Coriander Sauce. This was a nice pan Asian dish prepared with delicate sauce. The Texture of the dish was dark and thick whereas the aroma was very light on the nose. This is a stirred fried dish which is cooked along with spring onion , scallops and herbs. The panner is soft and tender and well submersed in the flavor of the Coriander sauce. A must try dish along with some drink.

Next up was the Dunger Panner Biriyani. This dish was more on presentation then its taste. The texture of the dish was rich and the aroma was very strong everyone in the hotel could smell the dish as it comes to your table.  The dish is mixed with a creamy panners and aromatic rice. This dish is best suited to have it along with a group of people at the end.

The last dish was the Desert i.e. Gulab Jamun Cheese Cake. The cake is exactly as it sounds it to be. This is a cheese cake filled with Gulab Jamun throughout. The cake is light with a crummy base and filled with lots of Gulab Jamun. I really liked this dish and ended up eating 2 of it. I recommend you to try this dish for sure
